prompt: If it takes 6 Kg of paint to paint all the surfaces of a cube, how many Kg does it take to paint all surfaces of both parts if it was to be split in half.
judge_reasoning: The correct total paint after splitting the cube is 8 kg because the split creates two additional cut faces whose combined area equals two of the original cube’s faces. Candidate 1 correctly accounts for this and gives 8 kg. Candidates 2 and 3 make incorrect assumptions about how many faces/area each half requires, yielding 3 kg and 12 kg. Candidate 4 is also incorrect because it undercounts the added surface area from the two cut faces, giving 7 kg.
